title: Japanese Proverbs, Haiku, and Idioms
length_rule: Both fields are shorter than 20 words. English uses a word regex with internal apostrophes and hyphens. Japanese word boundaries were checked with Apple Natural Language’s Japanese word tokenizer.
translation_note: Dictionary entries use selected English glosses or equivalent sayings. Haiku use new, concise English renderings. Dictionary type labels follow the selected JMdict senses.
collection_license: CC BY-SA 4.0. Public-domain Japanese poem texts retain their public-domain status.

jmdict.title: JMdict Japanese–English dictionary
jmdict.credit: Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group (EDRDG) and JMdict contributors
jmdict.changes: Selected one written form and one short English gloss from the relevant sense for each entry. The dictionary’s gloss wording is retained.

entries.japanese: 古池や蛙とびこむ水の音
entries.english:
The old pond
a frog leaps in
the sound of water
entries.author: Matsuo Bashō

entries.japanese: 閑さや岩にしみ入るせみの聲
entries.english:
Such stillness
the cicadas' voices
seep into stone
entries.author: Matsuo Bashō

entries.japanese: 夏草や兵どもが夢の跡
entries.english:
Summer grass
the trace
of warriors' dreams
entries.author: Matsuo Bashō

entries.japanese: 五月雨を集めて早し最上川
entries.english:
Gathering the summer rains
how swiftly
the Mogami runs
entries.author: Matsuo Bashō

entries.japanese: 荒海や佐渡に橫ふ天の川
entries.english:
A rough sea
the Milky Way stretches
across to Sado
entries.author: Matsuo Bashō

entries.japanese: 秋深き隣は何をする人ぞ
entries.english:
Autumn deepens
what does my neighbor
do with their days?
entries.author: Matsuo Bashō

entries.japanese: 旅に病んで夢は枯野をかけめぐる
entries.english:
Ill on the road
my dreams still wander
across the withered fields
entries.author: Matsuo Bashō

entries.japanese: 海暮れて鴨の聲ほのかに白し
entries.english:
Dusk over the sea
the ducks' voices
faintly white
entries.author: Matsuo Bashō

entries.japanese: 旅人と我名呼ばれん初時雨
entries.english:
Let them call me Traveler
the first winter shower
entries.author: Matsuo Bashō

entries.japanese: 初時雨猿も小簑をほしげなり
entries.english:
The first winter shower
even the monkey seems to want
a little straw cape
entries.author: Matsuo Bashō

entries.japanese: 花の雲鐘は上野か淺草か
entries.english:
A cloud of blossoms
is that bell from Ueno
or Asakusa?
entries.author: Matsuo Bashō

entries.japanese: 此道や行く人なしに秋の暮
entries.english:
This road
with no one on it
an autumn evening
entries.author: Matsuo Bashō

entries.japanese: 雲をり〳〵人を休める月見哉
entries.english:
Clouds from time to time
give us a rest
from moon-viewing
entries.author: Matsuo Bashō

entries.japanese: 名月や北國日和定めなき
entries.english:
Harvest moon
how changeable the weather
in the northern country
entries.author: Matsuo Bashō

entries.japanese: 初雪や水仙の葉のたわむ程
entries.english:
First snow
just enough to bend
the daffodil leaves
entries.author: Matsuo Bashō

entries.japanese: 初雪やかけかゝりたる橋のうへ
entries.english:
First snow
on the bridge
still being built
entries.author: Matsuo Bashō

entries.japanese: 茶の花に人里ちかき山路哉
entries.english:
Tea blossoms by the mountain path
a village must be near
entries.author: Matsuo Bashō

entries.japanese: 梅が香にのつと日の出る山路哉
entries.english:
Through the scent of plum blossoms
the sun suddenly rises
on the mountain path
entries.author: Matsuo Bashō

entries.japanese: 霞やら花の雲やら煙やら
entries.english:
Is it haze
a cloud of blossoms
or smoke?
entries.author: Matsuo Bashō

entries.japanese: 春なれや名もなき山の朝霞
entries.english:
So it is spring
morning haze
on a nameless mountain
entries.author: Matsuo Bashō

entries.japanese: 春の海ひねもすのたりのたりかな
entries.english:
The spring sea
all day long
rolling gently on
entries.author: Yosa Buson

entries.japanese: 菜の花や月は東に日は西に
entries.english:
Rapeseed blossoms
the moon in the east
the sun in the west
entries.author: Yosa Buson

entries.japanese: 涼しさや鐘をはなるるかねの音
entries.english:
Such coolness
the sound of the bell
leaves the bell behind
entries.author: Yosa Buson

entries.japanese: 夏河を越すうれしさよ手に草履
entries.english:
The joy of crossing
a summer river
sandals in my hand
entries.author: Yosa Buson

entries.japanese: 牡丹散て打かさなりぬ二三片
entries.english:
The peony sheds
two or three petals
one over another
entries.author: Yosa Buson

entries.japanese: 狐火やいづこ河内の麦畠
entries.english:
Foxfire
somewhere in the wheat fields
of Kawachi
entries.author: Yosa Buson

entries.japanese: さみだれや大河を前に家二軒
entries.english:
Summer rains
two houses facing
a great river
entries.author: Yosa Buson

entries.japanese: 去年より又さびしひぞ秋の暮
entries.english:
Lonelier still
than last year
this autumn dusk
entries.author: Yosa Buson

entries.japanese: あちらむきに鴫も立たり秋の暮
entries.english:
Facing away
a snipe takes flight
at autumn dusk
entries.author: Yosa Buson

entries.japanese: 弓取に哥とはれけり秋の暮
entries.english:
A bowman asks me
for a poem
autumn dusk
entries.author: Yosa Buson

entries.japanese: 秋の暮辻の地藏に油さす
entries.english:
Autumn dusk
replenishing the lamp
at the roadside Jizō
entries.author: Yosa Buson

entries.japanese: 月天心貧しき町を通りけり
entries.english:
The moon straight overhead
I pass through
a poor neighborhood
entries.author: Yosa Buson

entries.japanese: 山は暮て野は黄昏の薄哉
entries.english:
The mountains darken
in the field, twilight
and silver grass
entries.author: Yosa Buson

entries.japanese: 鳥羽殿へ五六騎急ぐ野分かな
entries.english:
Five or six riders
hurry toward Toba Palace
in the autumn gale
entries.author: Yosa Buson

entries.japanese: 狐火や髑髏に雨のたまる夜に
entries.english:
Foxfire
on a night when rain
collects in a skull
entries.author: Yosa Buson

entries.japanese: 水鳥や舟に菜を洗ふ女有
entries.english:
Waterbirds
a woman in a boat
washing greens
entries.author: Yosa Buson

entries.japanese: 水鳥や枯木の中に駕二挺
entries.english:
Waterbirds
among the bare trees
two palanquins
entries.author: Yosa Buson

entries.japanese: 易水にねぶか流るゝ寒かな
entries.english:
A leek drifts down
the Yi River
how cold it is
entries.author: Yosa Buson

entries.japanese: 斧入れて香におどろくや冬こだち
entries.english:
The axe bites
the scent takes me by surprise
a winter grove
entries.author: Yosa Buson

entries.japanese: うまさふな雪やふふはりふふはりと
entries.english:
Delicious-looking snow
drifting down
ever so softly
entries.author: Kobayashi Issa
entries.source_locator: 扇面 うまさふな雪や

entries.japanese: 旅人がかきねにはさむおち穂哉
entries.english:
A traveler tucks
a fallen ear of rice
into the hedge
entries.author: Kobayashi Issa
entries.source_locator: 扇面 旅人がかきねに

entries.japanese: やれ打な蝿が手をすり足をする
entries.english:
Wait, don't swat it
the fly rubs its hands
rubs its feet
entries.author: Kobayashi Issa
entries.source_locator: 扇面 やれ打な蝿が

entries.japanese: 笠でするさらばさらばやうすがすみ
entries.english:
A wave of the hat
goodbye, goodbye
through the thin haze
entries.author: Kobayashi Issa
entries.source_locator: 扇面 窓前・軽井沢

entries.japanese: 評判の八重山ざくらあゝ老ぬ
entries.english:
That famous double mountain cherry
ah, I have grown old
entries.author: Kobayashi Issa
entries.source_locator: 扇面 評判の八重山ざくら

entries.japanese: 門の木の阿房烏も初声ぞ
entries.english:
Even the fool crow
in the tree by the gate
gives its first cry of the year
entries.author: Kobayashi Issa

entries.japanese: 雀の子そこのけ〳〵御馬が通る
entries.english:
Little sparrow
move aside, move aside
a horse is coming through
entries.author: Kobayashi Issa

entries.japanese: 松陰に寝てくふ六十よ州かな
entries.english:
In the shade of the pines
sixty-odd provinces
sleep and eat
entries.author: Kobayashi Issa
entries.source_locator: 書幅 松陰に寝てくふ

entries.japanese: 足枕手まくら鹿のむつまじや
entries.english:
A leg for a pillow, a foreleg for another
how tenderly the deer lie together
entries.author: Kobayashi Issa
entries.source_locator: 句稿 足枕手まくら

entries.japanese: なくななくなそれ程まめでかへる雁
entries.english:
Don't cry, don't cry
you're strong enough
to fly home, geese
entries.author: Kobayashi Issa
entries.source_locator: 色紙 なくななくな

entries.japanese: させる夜もなくてふりゆく萩の花
entries.english:
No night in particular
as the bush clover
sheds its flowers
entries.author: Kobayashi Issa
entries.source_locator: 半歌仙 させる夜も

entries.japanese: 井の中の蛙、大海を知らず
entries.english: the frog in the well knows nothing of the great ocean
the ground hardens after it rains
a skilled hawk hides its talons
even Kōbō Daishi's handwriting contains mistakes
good fortune and happiness will come to the home of those who smile

entries.japanese: 塵も積もれば山となる
entries.english: even dust becomes a mountain if piled together
the nail that sticks out gets hammered down
time is money
the grass is always greener on the other side of the fence
start with the first step
it's good to have a girl first and then a boy
even monkeys fall from trees
good things come to those who wait
like father, like son
sweet words only please a fool
more haste, less speed

entries.japanese: 郷に入っては郷に従え
entries.english: when in Rome, do as the Romans do
danger past, God forgotten
some things are better left unsaid
time flies like an arrow

entries.japanese: 三人寄れば文殊の知恵
entries.english: three heads are better than two
failure teaches success
misfortunes never come singly
you can get used to living anywhere
in spring one sleeps a sleep that knows no dawn
three women make a market
inscrutable are the ways of heaven
move with haste (when you have no doubts)
things to fear: earthquakes, thunder, fires and, most of all, fathers
it is darkest under the lamp post

entries.japanese: 馬鹿は死ななきゃ治らない
entries.english: once a fool, always a fool
necessity is the mother of invention
what's done is done
even the patience of a saint eventually runs out

entries.japanese: 坊主憎けりゃ袈裟まで憎い
entries.english: if you dislike someone, you will end up hating everything he stands for

entries.japanese: 落花枝に帰らず破鏡再び照らさず
entries.english: fallen blossom doesn't return to the branch, a broken mirror can not be made to shine
leave no room for scandal
it is simply common courtesy to clean up after yourself

entries.japanese: 屁と火事はもとから騒ぐ
entries.english: it is often the originator of problems who kicks up a fuss or complains loudest
there is no use shutting the stable door after the horse has bolted
some prefer nettles
poverty dulls the wit
a rolling stone gathers no moss

entries.japanese: 子を見ること親に如かず
entries.english: the parent is the best judge of the child

entries.japanese: 用心するに如くはない
entries.english: caution is the best policy
kindness begets kindness
the older, the wiser
anyone can make a mistake
duty ends only in death

entries.japanese: 天網恢恢疎にして漏らさず
entries.english: heaven's net has large meshes, but nothing escapes
nurture over nature
one can not serve two masters
there are brief moments of leisure even when at one's busiest

entries.japanese: 赤信号皆で渡れば怖くない
entries.english: if everyone crosses against the red light together, there's nothing to be afraid of
after pleasure comes pain
no one knows what the future holds
first come, first served
study hard and play hard
if you have a mind to do something, you can do it
anybody can look good with the right clothes
birds of a feather flock together
the end justifies the means

entries.japanese: 背に腹は変えられない
entries.english: you can't make an omelet without breaking eggs
the greater embraces the less

entries.japanese: 精神一到何事か成らざらん
entries.english: where there is a will, there is a way

entries.japanese: 渇しても盗泉の水を飲まず
entries.english: better starve than fatten on ill-gotten wealth
a burnt child dreads the fire

entries.japanese: 瓜の蔓に茄子はならぬ
entries.english: like begets like

entries.japanese: 虎穴に入らずんば虎子を得ず
entries.english: nothing ventured, nothing gained
there is a suitable spouse for everyone
enjoying a long life is a matter for congratulation

entries.japanese: 人事を尽くして天命を待つ
entries.english: man proposes, God disposes
love is blind
empty vessels make the most sound
there's but a fine line between genius and insanity
children do not know how dear they are to their parents (and therefore act selfishly)
you can't give what you don't have

entries.japanese: 負うた子に教えられて浅瀬を渡る
entries.english: some things can be learned from the young

entries.japanese: 溺れる者は藁をも掴む
entries.english: a drowning man will clutch at a straw

entries.japanese: 勝って兜の緒を締めよ
entries.english: do not let your guard down after a victory
avoid compromising situations

entries.japanese: かわいい子には旅をさせよ
entries.english: spare the rod and spoil the child
a cornered rat will bite a cat

entries.japanese: 窮鳥懐に入れば猟師もこれを殺さず
entries.english: even the hunter will refrain from killing the bird that has flown to him for shelter

entries.japanese: おごる平家久しからず
entries.english: pride goes before a fall

entries.japanese: 敵を欺くにはまず味方から
entries.english: in fooling the enemy first deceive your allies

entries.japanese: 入るを量りて出ずるを為す
entries.english: consider your income before spending

entries.japanese: 過ちては則ち改むるに憚ること勿れ
entries.english: when you make a mistake, don't hesitate to correct it
perseverance makes one stronger
the early bird gets the worm

entries.japanese: 雉も鳴かずば撃たれまい
entries.english: avoiding unnecessary talk can prevent disaster falling on one

entries.japanese: 事実は小説より奇なり
entries.english: truth is stranger than fiction
money comes and goes
inscrutable are the ways people are brought together
a diamond on a dunghill is still a diamond
there are wheels within wheels
one red flower standing out in a sea of green vegetation

entries.japanese: 門前の小僧習わぬ経を読む
entries.english: you learn, without realising it, from what is around you
a bad wife spells the ruin of her husband
even the hardest of hearts can be moved to tears
home is wherever one lays one's hat

entries.japanese: すまじきものは宮仕え
entries.english: cursed be working for others
reason ends where love begins
hardship makes the man
seeing is believing
women appear the most beautiful when viewed from afar, in the dark, or when wearing a bamboo hat
third time lucky

entries.japanese: 衣食足りて礼節を知る
entries.english: well-fed, well-bred

entries.japanese: 青は藍より出でて藍より青し
entries.english: the student has become the master
we meet only to part
the autumn sun sets as quickly as a bucket dropping into a well
nurture beats nature
slow but steady wins the race
the law has holes large enough for the most wicked men to slip through
perseverance prevails
dead men tell no tales

entries.japanese: 風が吹けば桶屋が儲かる
entries.english: any event can bring about an effect in an unexpected way

entries.japanese: 口では大坂の城も建つ
entries.english: talk is cheap

entries.japanese: 三尺去って師の影を踏まず
entries.english: a student must never forget to honor their teacher (honour)
one should not rush to make a profit
people may bring about their demise for love

entries.japanese: 壁に耳あり障子に目あり
entries.english: walls have ears
easy come, easy go
time waits for no man
deep rivers move in silence; shallow brooks are noisy
all people aren't evil
one cannot have pleasure without pain

entries.japanese: 楽は苦の種、苦は楽の種
entries.english: there's no pain without pleasure, and there's no pleasure without pain

entries.japanese: 山高きが故に貴からず
entries.english: don't judge a book by its cover
sickness and health start with the mind

entries.japanese: 柳の下にいつも泥鰌はおらぬ
entries.english: a fox is not taken twice in the same snare
the soft may prove more durable than the hard
you get what you pay for
it often takes time for one's actions to bear fruit

entries.japanese: 一年の計は元旦にあり
entries.english: the whole year's plans should be made on New Year's Day
one man's meat is another man's poison

entries.japanese: 本木にまさる末木なし
entries.english: of soup and love, the first is the best
the most helpful advice may be difficult to listen to

entries.japanese: 目は口ほどに物を言う
entries.english: one can say more with a look than with ten thousand words

entries.japanese: 金の切れ目が縁の切れ目
entries.english: relationships formed by wealth will end when the money ends
in traveling, a companion; in life, sympathy

entries.japanese: 人の口には戸が立てられない
entries.english: you can't control what people say

entries.japanese: 若い時の苦労は買うてもせよ
entries.english: spare no effort while you are young
men should be brave, women should be affable
there's always room for dessert
half a loaf is better than none
even a homely girl looks beautiful at the peak of her youth

entries.japanese: 少年老い易く学成り難し
entries.english: study hard while you are young

entries.japanese: 一寸の光陰軽んずべからず
entries.english: there isn't a moment to be wasted
a poor man has no time for leisure

entries.japanese: 天は自ら助くる者を助く
entries.english: heaven helps those who help themselves
the pen is mightier than the sword
a jack of all trades is a master of none
speech is silver, silence is golden
strike while the iron is hot

entries.japanese: 働かざる者食うべからず
entries.english: if man will not work, he shall not eat

entries.japanese: 死んで花実が咲くものか
entries.english: once you're dead, that's it
with time we forget those who have died
the blind leading the blind

entries.japanese: 己の欲せざる所は人に施す勿れ
entries.english: do not do unto others what you would not have done unto you
love your enemies
love your neighbour (neighbor)

entries.japanese: 過ちて改めざるこれを過ちという
entries.english: a man who has committed a mistake and doesn't correct it is committing another mistake

entries.japanese: 千金の裘は一狐の腋に非ず
entries.english: to rule a country requires many great men

entries.japanese: 宝さかって入る時はさかって出る
entries.english: ill-gotten gains fade as fast as they were obtained

entries.japanese: 犬も歩けば棒に当たる
entries.english: bad things happen to those who attempt things
the proof of the pudding is in the eating
a gentle spirit is more important than looks
children are a bond between husband and wife

entries.japanese: 月夜の晩ばかりじゃない
entries.english: you better watch your step!
curiosity killed the cat

entries.japanese: 親しき仲にも礼儀あり
entries.english: good fences make good neighbors
victory depends on the turn of fortune
followers take after their leaders
a man's word is his bond
if you are prepared you don't have to worry

entries.japanese: 情けは人のためならず
entries.english: the good you do for others is good you do yourself

entries.japanese: 冬来たりなば春遠からじ
entries.english: when winter comes spring isn't far behind
experience is the best teacher
it's always darkest before the dawn

entries.japanese: 日光を見ずして結構と言うなかれ
entries.english: see Nikko and die

entries.japanese: 船頭多くして船山に登る
entries.english: too many cooks spoil the broth

entries.japanese: 女房と畳は新しい方が良い
entries.english: wives and tatami mats are best when new

entries.japanese: 案ずるより産むが易し
entries.english: it is easier to do something than worry about it
a leopard cannot change its spots

entries.japanese: 幽霊の正体見たり枯れ尾花
entries.english: fear makes the wolf bigger than he is
smooth words make smooth ways

entries.japanese: 過ぎたるは及ばざるがごとし
entries.english: the last drop makes the cup run over
fair words fill not the belly
speak of the devil and he shall appear
the best time for doing something is as soon as you've thought of it
great men have great fondness for the sensual pleasures
honesty does not pay

entries.japanese: 鬼が出るか蛇が出るか
entries.english: God only knows what may happen
prevention is better than cure

entries.japanese: 下手な考え休むに似たり
entries.english: it's hard to tell a poor thinker from a sleeping one
do not chase the one who leaves
turn away no one

entries.japanese: 用心するに越したことはない
entries.english: you can never be too careful
see Naples and die

entries.japanese: ローマは一日にして成らず
entries.english: Rome was not built in a day

entries.japanese: 悪人は畳の上では死ねない
entries.english: a bad person does not deserve to die in his own bed
a law is a law, however undesirable it may be
whatever will be, will be

entries.japanese: 衣ばかりで和尚はできぬ
entries.english: the clothes do not make the man

entries.japanese: 一寸の虫にも五分の魂
entries.english: tread on a worm and it will turn

entries.japanese: 一銭を笑う者は一銭に泣く
entries.english: take care of the penny
faith will move mountains

entries.japanese: 嘘つきは泥棒の始まり
entries.english: show me a liar, and I will show you a thief
there's no flying from fate

entries.japanese: 遠くの親類より近くの他人
entries.english: a neighbour is better than a relative living far
poor speakers make long speeches

entries.japanese: 可愛さ余って憎さ百倍
entries.english: the greatest hate proceeds from the greatest love

entries.japanese: 火のないところに煙は立たない
entries.english: there's no smoke without fire

entries.japanese: 稼ぐに追いつく貧乏なし
entries.english: poverty is a stranger to industry

entries.japanese: 我が身をつねって人の痛さを知れ
